tests.description: one offline provider round containing three calls stops after two actual invocations when maxToolCalls is two and returns tool-call-budget
tests.criterion: AC3: configured call budget stops execution with a truthful terminal reason

tests.description: maxToolCalls two limits a three-call batch even when maxRounds is independently configured to one
tests.criterion: AC3: maxToolCalls counts actual tool invocations and is not represented by maxRounds

tests.description: subprocess with no selected suites writes one JSON report under --out and records maxRounds from KERYX_AGENT_MAX_ROUNDS
tests.criterion: AC4: stress JSON creation uses an existing resolver and writes an offline fixture report

tests.description: the pure containment port seam preserves a concrete bound listener port
tests.criterion: AC4: optional containment port is narrowed before case construction

tests.description: the pure containment port seam throws when Bun reports no bound port instead of choosing a fallback
tests.criterion: AC4: optional containment port has no unsafe default

tests.description: the scripts config resolves the named benchmark/stress entrypoints and compiles the current script set cleanly
tests.criterion: AC5: a separate scripts TypeScript check covers benchmark and stress scripts

tests.description: a temporary config extending the real scripts target rejects an injected strict assignment error with TS2322
tests.criterion: AC5: the scripts TypeScript check fails on an injected type error

notes: No live provider is constructed or called. The agent tests use an in-memory ProviderPort. The stress test launches the executable only with an unmatched --only selector and a temporary --out directory, so it runs report serialization without any suite or model call. run-containment.ts is safe to import because its main function is guarded by import.meta.main. The required test seam is a small exported pure function resolveContainmentPort(port: number | undefined): number on that existing entrypoint: return a valid concrete port and throw on undefined/invalid input; no separate support-module layout is required. commit_test_stubs=false; no git or flow state was mutated.
